extracted.intended_audience: general readers and Wikipedia editors/contributors interested in CBS News
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia encyclopedia article summarizing the history, programs, personnel, operations, and criticism of the CBS News division. Serves as a reference entry intended for general audiences and for collaborative editing by Wikipedia contributors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citations to reliable sources / verifiability
rubrics_metrics.description: This section does not cite any sources. Please help improve this section by adding citations to reliable sources. Unsourced material may be challenged and removed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material in the article (and in specific sections flagged) should be supported by citations to reliable sources; unsourced or poorly sourced content may be challenged and removed. Editors are prompted to add citations and to learn how/when to remove the maintenance message.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use American English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article language should follow American English spelling and usage conventions as indicated by the article's language/locale settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use mdy date format
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates in the article should be formatted month–day–year (mdy) consistent with the article's style settings.
